purpose: Route verified channel-derived P1/P2 candidate knowledge without giving the mentor any video acquisition, selector, ASR, AGY, or Distilly ownership.

use_policy.formal_p0: Use only scoped formal rules from normalized_principles.json with their provenance.
use_policy.p1_p2_candidates: Use only when a candidate directly helps formulate hypotheses or a discriminating experiment; label it CANDIDATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED and cite its candidate ID plus source provenance.
use_policy.p3_archive: Never use archive/logistics coverage as a recipe rule or teacher-attributed ML conclusion.
use_policy.missing_or_drifted_index: Report the candidate layer unavailable instead of inventing a fallback citation.
